title.rendered: Xech- Desk Boss Table Clock with Speaker

content.rendered:
Xech- Desk Boss Table Clock with Speaker

Introducing Deskboss, Dark Edition. Encased in a premium dark rubber finish, this hybrid device combines the functionalities of everything you need at your desk to become a master of multitasking.

The face features a stylish mirror display clock with an alarm & temperature sensor & a calendar. It features a smart auto-sync function which automatically sets the date & time, eliminating the need for manual setting.

Deskboss houses a hi-fidelity 10W wireless speaker and ambient RGB lights to ensure that the vibes are always up at your desk.

At the top, we’ve included a pen stand & stationery holder with a special groove that serves as a smartphone dock.

Say goodbye to old-fashioned stationery holders and say hello to the boss!

FEATURES

  • Digital Clock with Alarm with Mirror Finish: Bright LEDs ensure that you see the time clearly, even in the dark.
  • USB C Powered: Deskboss can be powered using a USB port and even has an emergency battery backup which lasts for 12 hours incase of a power outage.
  • 10W Speaker with Enhanced Bass: Immerse yourself in powerful sound with enhanced bass performance.
  • RGB Bluetooth Speaker with Ambient Lighting: Create an immersive audio-visual experience with captivating RGB lights.
  • Speaker with Phone Holder for Hands-Free Convenience: Your own Mini TV Setup. Enjoy immerssive content hands-free!
  • Versatile Multifunctional Speaker for Home and Office: Elevate your space with impressive audio performance and a premium design.
  • The Deskboss table clock with speaker comes with a 1 year warranty, the customer can reach out to the brand’s support team via email or whatsapp for further assistance
